title: workspace
subHeroTitle: One company. Many teams. Total access control.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ gives every organization a clean structure — your company at the top, individual project spaces below — with precise control over who can see and do what.

sections.title: Your company, organized from the top down
sections.desc: Your organization is the home for your whole company. Inside it, you create individual spaces for each team or project — each with its own tasks, conversations, and documents.

gridItems.title: Your organization
gridItems.desc: The top-level account for your whole company — where billing, members, and settings all live.

gridItems.title: Project spaces
gridItems.desc: Separate workspaces for each team or project, each with its own tasks, channels, and documents.

gridItems.title: Default welcome space
gridItems.desc: New team members land here automatically when they join. They can start contributing right away without needing setup.

sections.title: Precise control over who can do what
sections.desc: Set roles at both the company level and the space level. Admins can manage the workspace, managers can create and assign work, and members can contribute — each within their own boundaries.

gridItems.title: Company-level roles
gridItems.desc: Owners control billing and company-wide settings. Admins manage members and spaces. Everyone else gets access to only what they need.

gridItems.title: Space-level roles
gridItems.desc: Assign admin, manager, or member roles per space — so each team controls their own workspace without affecting others.

gridItems.title: Lockout protection
gridItems.desc: The system prevents anyone from accidentally removing the last admin from a workspace, so you're never locked out of your own account.

capabilitiesTitle: Structure that scales with your team.
capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ keeps every project, team, and permission organized so your workspace grows cleanly as your company does.
checklistTitle: Everyone in the right place, with the right access
checklistDesc: KeilHQ's permission system is simple enough for a small team and robust enough for a growing company.
checklistItems: Organize your company into separate workspaces for each team or project — each one isolated with its own tasks and conversations.
New team members are automatically placed into your default space so they can get started immediately.
Set who can manage, create, or just view — at both the company level and the individual space level.
The system prevents accidental lockouts so no workspace ever ends up without an admin.
Owners control billing and company-wide settings, keeping sensitive configuration away from everyday users.
